title: Colony and Orbit
author: Beatrix Almeida
blurb: Dominic Thackeray, the last human technician on an automated relay station, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the fleet's truce expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
